messages:
elaine (finance): Heads-up: on 2026-07-15 were launching two coordinated billing changes: (1) graduated overage smoothing (to reduce surprise overage hits) and (2) replacing the old unlimited trial credit with a $150 starter credit valid for 45 days. Dry-run telemetry begins 2026-06-20.

henry (eng-infra): Implementation notes: smoothing is route-level and uses a 15m rolling window with three tiers (minute-bursts, 1h sustained, 6h sustained). We'll emit X-Redwood-Smoothing headers during dry-run and a new CSV advisory column smoothing_adjusted_tokens. Feature flag smoothing_route_window controls rollout.

elaine (finance): During dry-run well only emit telemetry and advisory CSV columns; no billing changes until 7/15. After cutover invoices will include billing_tokens vs reported_tokens. Finance will run parallel reconciliations for a sample of customers.

zara (support): CS FAQ draft: "Will this lower my bill?" Short: "Not automatically. The smoothing buffer reduces volatility; sustained usage is billable. If you see unexpected shifts, contact support with your account ID." Will prep canned replies and a triage checklist (check headers, check usage API, check console banner).

kevin (growth): For signup flow: new starter credit = $150, auto-applied for accounts created after 2026-07-15. Update trial docs and AE templates. Marketing to prepare a short post focused on predictability (draft due 2026-06-10).

tom (product): Action items: eng (henry) - enable dry-run and headers; finance (elaine) - prep reconciliation plan and CSV mapping guide; support (zara) - canned replies; growth (kevin) - signup copy. Post playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/overage-smoothing (internal).

ops-bot: scheduled task created: smoothing-dryrun-metrics-collection start=2026-06-20T00:00:00Z owner=eng-infra :white_check_mark:

elaine (finance): Risks: automated reconciliation scripts breaking; tax/tier interactions. Mitigations: 4-week notice, dual CSVs during dry-run, sample reconciliations for top accounts.

tom (product): We'll announce to customers the week of 2026-06-22. If anything urgent, ping me directly.
